reason: A browser UI adapter that mounts DSH slot trees as native Custom Elements and manages declared property, event, and lifecycle bindings.

summaries.zh: 将 DSH 插槽树挂载为原生 Custom Elements，并处理声明式属性、事件和生命周期绑定的浏览器端适配器。
summaries.en: A browser-side adapter that mounts DSH slot trees as native Custom Elements and handles declared property, event, and lifecycle bindings.

capabilities: Mounts registered slot trees as native Custom Elements
Binds declared properties and events to browser DOM elements
Projects browser slot state and CustomEvent details through an adapter
